authorization_policy.detail: authenticated and not permitted to read GET /v1.0/policies/authorizationPolicy; GET /v1.0/roleManagement/directory/roleAssignments ($filter on the Global Administrator template, $select only); GET /v1.0/users/{id}?$select=id,onPremisesSyncEnabled (once per principal, so that no display name is ever received). Least privilege for this surface is Policy.Read.All, RoleManagement.Read.Directory.
